---
title: "Epidemiological Surveillance Dashboard"
subtitle: "Disease testing, bleeding symptoms, fever and regional trends"
author: "Disease Surveillance"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: cosmo
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(readxl)
library(scales)

# Import the surveillance dataset
EPo2_clean <- read_excel("EPo2.xlsx")

# Variables for disease test results
disease_cols <- c(
  "Marburg", "Lassa_fever", "Dengue", "Yellow_Fever"
)

# Validate required columns
required_cols <- c(
  "Years", "Region", "AgeGroup", "Sex", "Fever",
  "Bleeding", "Bleeding_type", disease_cols
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(EPo2_clean))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Standardise disease test-result labels
EPo2_clean <- EPo2_clean %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(disease_cols),
      ~ toupper(trimws(as.character(.x)))
    ),
    Years = as.numeric(as.character(Years)),
    Region = as.character(Region),
    AgeGroup = as.character(AgeGroup),
    Fever = toupper(trimws(as.character(Fever))),
    Bleeding = toupper(trimws(as.character(Bleeding))),
    Bleeding_type = as.character(Bleeding_type)
  )

# Convert the four test variables into long format
disease_long <- EPo2_clean %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(disease_cols),
    names_to = "Disease",
    values_to = "Result"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Disease = recode(
      Disease,
      Marburg = "Marburg",
      Lassa_fever = "Lassa fever",
      Dengue = "Dengue",
      Yellow_Fever = "Yellow fever"
    ),
    Result = toupper(trimws(Result))
  )

# Overall summary for each disease
test_summary <- disease_long %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_records = n(),
    Tested = sum(
      Result %in% c("POSITIVE", "NEGATIVE"),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Positive = sum(Result == "POSITIVE", na.rm = TRUE),
    Negative = sum(Result == "NEGATIVE", na.rm = TRUE),
    Not_done = sum(Result == "NOT DONE", na.rm = TRUE),
    Missing = sum(is.na(Result) | Result == "", na.rm = TRUE),
    Positivity_percent = ifelse(
      Tested > 0, 100 * Positive / Tested, NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Summary cards: patient records and test results
total_records <- nrow(EPo2_clean)

total_positive_tests <- sum(
  disease_long$Result == "POSITIVE", na.rm = TRUE
)

total_completed_tests <- sum(
  disease_long$Result %in% c("POSITIVE", "NEGATIVE"),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

total_bleeding <- sum(
  EPo2_clean$Bleeding == "YES", na.rm = TRUE
)

total_fever <- sum(
  EPo2_clean$Fever == "YES", na.rm = TRUE
)

# Colour palette
surveillance_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

Sidebar
=====================================

```{r}
selectInput(
  "region_filter",
  "Select region",
  choices = c("All regions", sort(unique(
    na.omit(EPo2_clean$Region)
  ))),
  selected = "All regions"
)

selectInput(
  "year_filter",
  "Select year",
  choices = c("All years", sort(unique(
    na.omit(EPo2_clean$Years)
  ))),
  selected = "All years"
)

selectInput(
  "age_filter",
  "Select age group",
  choices = c("All age groups", sort(unique(
    na.omit(EPo2_clean$AgeGroup)
  ))),
  selected = "All age groups"
)

selectInput(
  "disease_filter",
  "Select disease",
  choices = c(
    "All diseases", "Marburg", "Lassa fever",
    "Dengue", "Yellow fever"
  ),
  selected = "All diseases"
)
```

```{r}
filtered_data <- reactive({
  dat <- EPo2_clean

  if (input$region_filter != "All regions") {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(Region == input$region_filter)
  }

  if (input$year_filter != "All years") {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(Years == as.numeric(input$year_filter))
  }

  if (input$age_filter != "All age groups") {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(AgeGroup == input$age_filter)
  }

  dat
})

filtered_long <- reactive({
  dat <- filtered_data() %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(disease_cols),
      names_to = "Disease",
      values_to = "Result"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Disease = recode(
        Disease,
        Marburg = "Marburg",
        Lassa_fever = "Lassa fever",
        Dengue = "Dengue",
        Yellow_Fever = "Yellow fever"
      ),
      Result = toupper(trimws(as.character(Result)))
    )

  if (input$disease_filter != "All diseases") {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(Disease == input$disease_filter)
  }

  dat
})
```

Testing Summary
=====================================

Row
-------------------------------------

### Total patient records

```{r}
renderValueBox({
  valueBox(
    value = comma(nrow(filtered_data())),
    caption = "Patient records",
    icon = "fa-users",
    color = "primary"
  )
})
```

### Completed tests

```{r}
renderValueBox({
  dat <- filtered_long()
  n <- sum(
    dat$Result %in% c("POSITIVE", "NEGATIVE"),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  valueBox(
    comma(n),
    "Completed disease tests",
    icon = "fa-vial",
    color = "info"
  )
})
```

### Positive test results

```{r}
renderValueBox({
  n <- sum(filtered_long()$Result == "POSITIVE", na.rm = TRUE)

  valueBox(
    comma(n),
    "Positive test results",
    icon = "fa-check-circle",
    color = "danger"
  )
})
```

### Patients reporting bleeding

```{r}
renderValueBox({
  n <- sum(filtered_data()$Bleeding == "YES", na.rm = TRUE)

  valueBox(
    comma(n),
    "Records with bleeding",
    icon = "fa-heartbeat",
    color = "warning"
  )
})
```

Row
-------------------------------------

### Testing results by disease

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  dat <- filtered_long() %>%
  filter(Result %in% c("POSITIVE", "NEGATIVE")) %>%
  count(Disease, Result, name = "Count") %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  mutate(Positive_Total = sum(Count[Result == "POSITIVE"])) %>%
  ungroup()

validate(need(nrow(dat) > 0, "No test results for this selection."))

p <- ggplot(
  dat,
  aes(
    x = reorder(Disease, Positive_Total),
    y = Count,
    fill = Result,
    text = paste0(
      "Disease: ", Disease,
      "<br>Result: ", Result,
      "<br>Count: ", comma(Count)
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(
    title = "Disease testing outcomes",
    x = "Disease",
    y = "Number of tests",
    fill = "Test result"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
})
```

### Testing and positivity summary

```{r}
renderDT({
  dat <- filtered_long() %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  summarise(
    Tested = sum(
      Result %in% c("POSITIVE", "NEGATIVE"),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Negative = sum(Result == "NEGATIVE", na.rm = TRUE),
    Positive = sum(Result == "POSITIVE", na.rm = TRUE),
    Positivity_percent = ifelse(
      Tested > 0, 100 * Positive / Tested, NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Positive))

dat %>%
  mutate(
    Positivity_percent = round(Positivity_percent, 1)
  ) %>%
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      order = list(list(3, "desc"))
    )
  ) %>%
  formatRound("Positivity_percent", 1)
})
```

Bleeding and Fever
=====================================

Row
-------------------------------------

### Bleeding by fever status

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  dat <- filtered_data() %>%
    mutate(
      Fever = ifelse(
        is.na(Fever) | Fever == "", "Missing", Fever
      ),
      Bleeding = ifelse(
        is.na(Bleeding) | Bleeding == "", "Missing", Bleeding
      )
    ) %>%
    count(Fever, Bleeding, name = "Count")

  p <- ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(
      x = Fever, y = Count, fill = Bleeding,
      text = paste0(
        "Fever: ", Fever,
        "<br>Bleeding: ", Bleeding,
        "<br>Records: ", comma(Count)
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    labs(
      title = "Bleeding status by fever status",
      x = "Fever", y = "Number of records",
      fill = "Bleeding"
    ) +
    theme_classic()

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
})
```

### Bleeding types among patients with fever

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  dat <- filtered_data() %>%
    filter(Fever == "YES", Bleeding == "YES") %>%
    mutate(
      Bleeding_type = ifelse(
        is.na(Bleeding_type) | Bleeding_type == "",
        "Not recorded", Bleeding_type
      )
    ) %>%
    count(Bleeding_type, sort = TRUE, name = "Count")

  validate(need(
    nrow(dat) > 0,
    "No records with both fever and bleeding for this selection."
  ))

  p <- ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(
      x = reorder(Bleeding_type, Count), y = Count,
      text = paste0(
        Bleeding_type, ": ", comma(Count)
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(fill = "#E69F00") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Bleeding types among fever patients",
      x = "Bleeding type", y = "Number of records"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
})
```

Positive Cases by Year, Age Group and Region
=====================================

Row
-------------------------------------

### Positive cases by age group

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  dat <- filtered_long() %>%
  filter(Result == "POSITIVE", !is.na(AgeGroup)) %>%
  count(AgeGroup, Disease, name = "Positive") %>%
  group_by(AgeGroup) %>%
  mutate(Total_Positive = sum(Positive)) %>%
  ungroup()

validate(need(nrow(dat) > 0, "No positive results for this selection."))

p <- ggplot(
  dat,
  aes(
    x = reorder(AgeGroup, Total_Positive),
    y = Positive,
    fill = Disease,
    text = paste0(
      "Age group: ", AgeGroup,
      "<br>Disease: ", Disease,
      "<br>Positive tests: ", comma(Positive),
      "<br>Total positives in age group: ", comma(Total_Positive)
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(
    title = "Positive test results by age group",
    x = "Age group",
    y = "Number of positive tests",
    fill = "Disease"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
})
```

### Positive Cases by Region and Year

```{r}
renderPlotly({

  dat <- filtered_long() %>%
    filter(
      Result == "POSITIVE",
      !is.na(Region),
      !is.na(Years)
    ) %>%
    count(Years, Region, Disease, name = "Positive")

  validate(
    need(
      nrow(dat) > 0,
      "No positive results for this selection."
    )
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(
      x = Region,
      y = Positive,
      fill = Disease,
      text = paste0(
        "Year: ", Years,
        "<br>Region: ", Region,
        "<br>Disease: ", Disease,
        "<br>Positive cases: ", comma(Positive)
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    facet_grid(~ Years) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Positive Cases by Region and Year",
      subtitle = "Distribution of positive test results by disease",
      x = "Region",
      y = "Number of positive tests",
      fill = "Disease"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(
      legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15),
      margin = list(b = 100)
    )
})
```
